verdict.rationale: Every documented Bugbot surface runs on pull requests after push. That covers automatic PR reviews, `cursor review` comments, and inline PR comments on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps. 'Fix in Cursor' links only open existing PR findings in the editor, which is an adjacent feature, not a pre-push in-IDE review. One community remark about IDE review comments is a user's assumption, not documented Bugbot capability.
